annotation.title_en: Diia.AI: Ukraine's National AI Agent for Government Services
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Interoperable Europe Portal – Public Sector Tech Watch
annotation.venue: Interoperable Europe Portal (Public Sector Tech Watch)
annotation.summary_en: An EU Public Sector Tech Watch case page on Diia.AI, an AI agent built by Ukraine's Ministry of Digital Transformation. It handles government services through a chat. The page covers its agentic LangGraph architecture, its hybrid Gemini infrastructure, PII anonymisation, guardrails, a citation system for transparency, and interoperability under the European Interoperability Framework. It won the 2025 SEMIC Best Cases Award.
key_provisions_or_claims: Diia.AI goes beyond answering questions: it carries out government services for citizens inside a chat
A four-stage PII protection step anonymises personal data before it reaches the LLM
Guardrails tuned for Ukrainian protect against prompt injection and harmful outputs
Interoperability follows the European Interoperability Framework and uses MCP to connect to registries
Citations link each answer to verified source documents to support transparency
